_comment: Illusionist (Mystic) hero. Once per Turn Instant - {c}{c}{c}: Create a Spectral Shield token with a +1{p} counter. Also: your first Spectral Shield attack each turn costs {r} less to activate. Modeled as activation_cost 3 -> CREATE_TOKEN spectral_shield; the +1{p} counter and the cost-reduction static are omitted. NOTE: no Mystic hero is Classic Constructed legal; used here as the Mystic representative for card-testing coverage.
